title: Period products belong in the plan: preference, washing and disposal
description: Make a private, product-specific supply plan that people will actually be comfortable using.
alt: READY poster saying Remember period products, beside a bathroom cupboard with plain packs, folded underwear and a lidded bin. Ask preferences, keep suitable spares, and plan washing and disposal.

title: Boil water, do not drink, do not use: read the instruction before choosing a response
description: Three water notices require different decisions. Make a short record of the actual instruction, affected uses and next update.
alt: READY poster beside a kitchen tap, unplugged kettle and water bottle. Text distinguishes boil water, do not drink and do not use, and says to follow supplier advice.

title: A yellow weather warning is a starting point, not your finished decision
description: Read the place, timing, impacts and likelihood, then record the decision that applies to your own plans.
alt: READY poster saying yellow is only the start of the information, beside a map, phone and notebook by a rainy window. Read the place, time, impacts and likelihood.
